infinite.title: ♾️ Infinite Map Challenge
infinite.description:
A random map with a random combination of filters. You get one guess per map.

Correct answers build a consecutive streak. A wrong guess or skipping a map resets your current streak. Your current and best streaks are shown on every map and result.

Submit your answer with **/guessinfinite**, or press **{skip_button}** to reveal it. After either, the button becomes **{next_button}**.

This mode awards no points, but you can see the longest streaks with **/guessmap infiniteleaderboard**.
infinite.footer: Unscored fun mode • Streak leaderboard only • No points
